messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: high error rate from api.redwood-inference.prod (page to @oncall)
PagerDuty: Page fired to team:ops-oncall, escalation level 1 -> 5 minutes
Maya Chen: acked. I'm on it. Seeing customer reports of 502/524 from EU and US regions.
Samir Patel: I'm pulling LB metrics, give me a sec.
Maya Chen: Repro from my laptop: curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.prod/health -> TLS handshake timeout, then 522.
Lina Ortega: @Maya can you paste the exact curl output?
Maya Chen: ```
*   Trying 10.11.12.13:443...
* Connected to api.redwood-inference.prod (10.11.12.13) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.3 handshake, TLS_Extension, server hello (2): no peer certificate available
* SSL connection using TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
* TLSv1.3 (INTERNAL_ERROR)
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) OpenSSL SSL_connect: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL in connection to api.redwood-inference.prod:443 
```
Samir Patel: ALB target group shows 0/3 healthy in eu-west-1 for tg-prod-api. Health checks failing with TLS handshake errors on backend.
Ops-Bot: lb-healthcheck-monitor: tg-prod-api (eu-west-1) -> 0/3 healthy (last failing check 1746504289)
Ethan Ross: Any recent deploys to prod in the last 30m?
Maya Chen: No deploys. Console shows no active rollouts. No config pushes in CICD.
Lina Ortega: dig +trace api.redwood-inference.prod -> DNS resolution looks fine across regions but TTL is 300s. Some resolvers still have old IPs that point to the old NGINX LB.
Samir Patel: Checking Nginx logs on targets -> repeated "ssl_handshake_failure" and client_hello errors. Could be cert rotation issue or SNI mismatch.
Maya Chen: Checking certs on backend: cert last rotated 2026-02-28, valid. But backend NGINX config was changed to require client-cert in a recent internal change? Looking at git history now.
Samir Patel: I can see a config rollback attempt from Lina earlier today: nginx.conf had a stray `ssl_verify_client on;` added in /etc/nginx/conf.d/proxy.conf
Lina Ortega: That must be it. I added that to enforce mTLS for internal test, forgot to gate by env. Rolling back now.
Maya Chen: While Lina rolls back, I'm going to bounce nginx on targets one-by-one to recover health.
Ops-Bot: action: rolling-restart targets in tg-prod-api: i-0a12, i-0b34, i-0c56 (graceful)
Samir Patel: Also adding a temporary LB level fallback: route EU traffic to dedicated fallback pool (dedicated-capacity-1) to reduce customer impact.
Ethan Ross: Good. Open an incident doc and set severity to Sev2 for customer-facing 50% error rate.
Maya Chen: Incident doc started: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-045 (brief: lb tls fail after accidental mTLS toggle)
Lina Ortega: Rollback applied and nginx config reloaded on i-0a12. Health checks now show 1/3.
Samir Patel: Restart complete on i-0b34 and i-0c56. ALB target health -> 3/3 healthy in eu-west-1 at 1746504628. Monitoring shows 5xx rate dropping.
Maya Chen: Confirming: curl https://api.redwood-inference.prod/health -> 200 OK from my EU ip. Latency normal.
PagerDuty: Page acknowledged by Maya Chen at 1746504330; status -> acknowledged
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated to degraded state. Please monitor for 30m and keep the incident doc updated.
Ethan Ross: Thanks team. Next steps: add a CI gating check to prevent ssl_verify_client from being enabled in prod configs, add a postmortem owner, lower DNS TTL to 60 during rollbacks for faster propagation next time.
Samir Patel: I'll handle the postmortem and the CI guard. ETA for writeup: EOD.
Maya Chen: Handoff: Samir will own the overnight watch. I'll stay until 17:55 PDT and then hand off to Lina if anything flares.
Lina Ortega: I'm standing by. Removing temporary LB fallback after 30m if stable.
Ops-Bot: monitoring: 5xx rate eu-west-1 dropped from 48% -> 2% over 12 minutes. Alert auto-resolve scheduled in 20m.
incident-bot: :page_facing_up: Incident INC-2026-045 created and labeled "network/lb/tls". Severity: Sev2. Participants: Maya Chen, Samir Patel, Lina Ortega, Ethan Ross.
Maya Chen: marking thread resolved (for now), keeping incident doc open for postmortem notes.
